selection_rule: Select the first candidate in canonical-adjudication-batch2-v0.7.2.json whose decision is HOLD; this deterministically selects CANON-B2-ABRAMELIN.

records.tested_relationship: The S. L. MacGregor Mathers English translation titled The Book of the Sacred Magic of Abramelin the Mage and the Georg Dehn/Steven Guth 2006 English translation titled The Book of Abramelin: A New Translation represent the same underlying Abramelin work family, while remaining distinct translations/editions/manifestations.
records.rationale: Independent public library bibliography supports work-family identity without collapsing manifestation, edition, or translation distinctions. WorldCat identifies the Mathers-translated English title as an Abramelin work. CiNii identifies the 2006 Dehn/Guth translation as The book of Abramelin, records The Book of the Sacred Magic of Abramelin the Mage as an alternative title, and explicitly describes the 2006 publication as a modern translation following Mathers's earlier translation. This is sufficient only for REPRESENTS_WORK. It does not establish edition identity, translation identity, byte identity, rights/public-release status, scientific evidence, truth, safety, or efficacy.

provenance.bibliographic_fact: The book of the sacred magic of Abramelin the mage; Abraham ben Simeon and S. L. MacGregor Mathers; English print book; Dover Publications, 1975.

The book of Abramelin: a new translation; Abraham von Worms; compiled and edited by Georg Dehn; translated by Steven Guth; Ibis Press, 2006; ISBN 9780892541270; alternative title The Book of the Sacred Magic of Abramelin the Mage; note relates the edition to Mathers's earlier translation.
